LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony now serves the Aldmeri Dominion. Dominion outposts will pay and supply its people.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Enlist_Button_Desc: Join the Aldmeri Dominion and serve the elven nations against the younger races' empire.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Enlist_Requrements_: The Dominion does not yet trust you. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Enlisted_To_Hostile: The Dominion does not accept oaths from its enemies.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Missions_Desc: See what the Dominion needs done.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Menu_Missions_Desc: Directives from the Dominion command. Payment arrives once the task is reported complete.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Provisions_Desc: Rations and medicine from a Dominion outpost.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Storage_Desc: Leave goods at any Dominion outpost.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Dominion's service? Your standing will suffer.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony no longer serves the Aldmeri Dominion.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Resign_Button_Desc: Give up your oath to the Dominion.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Kick_Out_Label_Titl: The Dominion has struck the colony from its rolls.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Salary_Desc: Dominion coin from the Summerset treasury.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Work_0_Desc: Drill and march with Dominion soldiers.
LanguageData.ESCP_AldmeriDominion_Work_1_Desc: Ride between Dominion outposts with sealed letters.
